items.title: HUL upside maybe limited as margins face cost pressure
items.description: Hindustan Unilever shares fell sharply, reaching a 52-week low despite strong revenue growth. Input cost pressures caused a contraction in the company's Ebitda margin. Home care and beauty segments showed robust underlying sales growth during the quarter. Personal care faced challenges from palm oil inflation, while foods division saw steady expansion. Management anticipates improved performance but sustained cost inflation may limit future stock upside.

items.title: Asian Paints Q1 Results: Net profit surges 40% YoY to Rs 1,539 crore
items.description: Asian Paints Q1 Results: Asian Paints reported a strong Q1 FY27 performance, with consolidated net profit rising 40% year-on-year to Rs 1,539 crore, driven by robust demand and improved profitability. Consolidated net sales grew 18% to Rs 10,521 crore, while margins expanded on the back of calibrated price hikes, a better product mix, sourcing efficiencies and disciplined cost management.

items.title: Adani Ports Q1 Results: Net profit rises 9% YoY to Rs 3,620 crore, revenue jumps 19%
items.description: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zones announced a consolidated net profit of Rs 3,620 crore for the first quarter. This marks a significant nine percent year-on-year increase from the previous financial year's earnings. The company's revenue from operations also saw a substantial eighteen percent growth. This impressive financial performance reflects strong operational capabilities and market presence. Adani Ports continues its upward trajectory in the infrastructure sector.

items.title: Dhanlaxmi Bank Q1 profit more than doubles on lower provisions
items.description: Dhanlaxmi Bank reported a more than twofold rise in Q1 net profit to Rs 24.9 crore, driven by higher income and lower provisions. Asset quality improved with gross NPAs declining to 1.8%, while operating profit increased 55% year-on-year despite sequential moderation.

items.title: Bajaj Housing Finance Q1 Results: Net profit jumps 23% YoY to Rs 715 crore, AUM surges 24%
items.description: Bajaj Housing Finance Q1 Results: Bajaj Housing Finance on Wednesday reported a net profit of Rs 715 crore for the first quarter of FY27, marking a 23% year-on-year rise from the Rs 583 crore net profit reported in the corresponding quarter of FY27, with net interest income rising 9% YoY to Rs 968 crore.

items.title: Vedanta Oil & Gas Q1 Results: Co swings to black with Rs 945 crore profit, revenue up 9% YoY
items.description: Vedanta Oil & Gas posted a Rs 945 crore net profit for Q1 FY27. This marks a significant turnaround from the previous year's net loss. The company's revenue from operations also saw an increase of 8.5 percent. This profit was achieved despite reporting an exceptional net loss. The firm's financial performance shows positive momentum in the recent quarter.

items.title: Adani Enterprises Q1 Results: Co reports loss of Rs 1,160 cr on one-time expense; revenue surges 50% YoY
items.description: Adani Enterprises Q1 Results: Revenue from operations in the reporting period increased 50% year-on-year (YoY) to Rs 32,924 crore.

items.title: Dabur Q1 Results: Profit rises 15% to Rs 591 crore; revenue up 11%
items.description: Dabur India reported a 15% rise in Q1 consolidated net profit to Rs 591 crore, driven by price hikes, cost efficiencies and broad-based FMCG growth. Revenue rose 11%, rural demand outpaced urban markets, while international business and premium brands delivered strong momentum.
